details.policy: HTTP completeness and TCP EOF/reset are recorded separately. Moderate bounded inputs require EOF/no reset; 1 MiB hostile oversupply permits reset only after a complete validated response, bounded cleanup and successful resource/service recovery. No claim that every client can always read a response after arbitrary oversupply.

details.scope: Calls the actual production sendAll on a real AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM socketpair whose kernel send buffer is full. Peer never reads. Actual blocking timeout; no injected EAGAIN and no enlarged HTTP route. This directly tests sendAll, not a large-response HTTP endpoint.
Fixed deadline from worker entry, not connection acceptance/queue entry. Header receive only; response sending and connection cleanup retain separate bounds. No shortened test configuration.

isolation: CMake builds unmodified production sources in the artifact directory. LD_PRELOAD bind mapping redirects only 127.0.0.1:8080 in test child processes to temporary loopback ports. Normal timeout values unchanged. Only processes started by this suite are terminated.
